notes: List poisoning prevention: — private/loopback hosts (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `0.0.0.0`, `::1`) are now rejected at every insertion point: `saveProxiesToDatabase` and `deduplicateProxies` in WebScraper, `deduplicateCapturedProxies` (database-wide cleanup on dedup), `DatabaseOperations.ts` import path, and manual proxy add in ProxyChecker. A new `isPrivateHost` helper centralizes the check. Previously only the URL-based scraper filter caught these; fragmented insertion paths allowed them to leak in. | Proxy Checker timeout dropdown invisible options: — native `<option>` elements rendered with the OS default white background on dark theme, making unselected items unreadable. Added `style={{ background: 'var(--bg-primary)', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}` to each option to match the dark theme. | `deduplicateCapturedProxies` now cleans poisoned entries: — runs a `DELETE` for private/loopback hosts before deduplicating, so existing database entries are removed on next dedup cycle (triggered by scraping).
